source_scope: Existing Confluence source inventory versus current TIVERIT-BIM-STANDARDS main
purpose: Track source-to-current-main reconciliation and prevent stale branch comparisons from being treated as canonical migration gaps.
rules: Repository absence alone does not authorize promotion from source material.
Confluence presence alone does not make an item normative in the repository.
Reconciliation is against current main, not build/repository-foundation or another stale branch.
Object-level provenance must be preserved before promotion.
Remaining migration batches are generated from the reconciled delta.

domain_reconciliation.current_main_summary: The Navisworks source set has been reconciled object by object. Current repository coverage includes export instruction, project-setup standard, clash-matrix governance, technical coordination workflow, output-type governance, system-of-record boundaries, generic role authority, and abstract conformance tests. Draft/TODO values that depend on project configuration remain explicitly unpromoted.
